newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India's IOC seeks 25,000/T Nov fuel oil in tender.
newsitem.headline: India's IOC seeks 25,000/T Nov fuel oil in tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy high sulphur fuel oil for delivery in November, industry sources said on Wednesday.
The tender seeks 25,000 tonnes of 180-centistoke, 3.5-percent sulphur grade fuel oil for delivery to Bombay on the west coast of India between November 6-10.
The tender closes October 24 and is valid until October 25.
In its last tender, IOC purchased a 25,000 tonne cargo for delivery between October 15-19 to Goa/Kandla, west coast India at $12.75 per tonne on cost and freight basis over Mideast quotes.
The cargo was purchased from Mideast bunker trader, FAL Energy.
